text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I happen across<n>El Condor
Pasa and Grass Wonder<n>playing a game in the
central plaza.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Perfecto! Come judge our<n>coin flippin'
match!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The rules are a cinch. I flip the coin,<n>and Grass calls
heads or tails!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to spring this on you so<n>suddenly. El was
just so happy she<n>learned how to flip a coin.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Would you be willing to humor her for<n>a short
while?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so I somewhat forcibly end up<n>being the
referee for their game.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh! Let's get started!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: All right, Grass! Heads or tails?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hmm, what to choose? I'll go with...<n>tails?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Pobrecita! It's heads! I win!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh! Wanna go next,<n>Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: May I have another go first?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As Grass Wonder's trainer, I know<n>just how much
she hates to lose. Is<n>this game about to turn into a
battleground?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Which is it?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Perhaps... heads this time?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nope! Tails!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Tails?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Wrong!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That's ten wins in a row for me!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what Lady Luck has<n>against her, but
Grass Wonder can't<n>seem to win at all.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And once again, as her trainer, I can<n>sense that
behind her calm demeanor<n>lies an inferno that's
only growing<n>stronger!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The lunch period is almost over, so<n>let's do one
final round.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: One for all the marbles! Ready,<n>vamos!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Dah! Wh-whoa!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa fumbles before<n>catching the coin,
allowing me to see<n>that it landed on tails.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Phew! Nearly dropped it there! Now...<n>which is it?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The coin is hea...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Heads. The coin landed on heads.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder's chance to win it all<n>ends in failure.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your support, Trainer. I<n>truly
appreciated the gesture.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But... there's no point in winning if I<n>don't do it on
my own.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The next day, I spot her in the libraryreading a book titled Probability.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well... why don't we change thingsup a little? Which do you think it is,El?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Surely you can feel the difference<n>between heads
and tails by now?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh? A battle of wits now, is it? You're<n>on!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I think... tails!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Then... I'll take your word, El. The<n>coin is tails, no?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The battle for all the marbles comes<n>to a close with
Grass Wonder's<n>tactical adjustment resulting in
victory.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You know, Trainer, I think I<n>might actually
have your support to<n>thank for that victory.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Apparently Grass and El's contest<n>triggers a
full-on coin-flipping fad in<n>their class, and a few
days later, I see<n>everyone outside playing together.
